$schema_note: Kandha Stole tap language, protocol v1. Single source of truth: the app (app/kandha/patterns.py), the on-screen virtual stole (browser/kandha/stole-view.js), the tests and the firmware header (firmware/kandha/patterns.h, generated by scripts/generate_kandha_patterns.py) are all built from this file. Edit here, then run the generator.
step_semantics: Each step drives the selected zones at `level` (0-255 PWM duty, scaled by the command intensity and the per-zone CONFIG scale) for `on_ms`, then rests for `off_ms`. `repeat` plays the whole step list that many times. A new HAPTIC command replaces whatever is playing. Pattern 0 stops.

patterns.name: Someone starts speaking
patterns.meaning: One firm tap on the shoulder on that person's side. Look there.

patterns.name: A new voice
patterns.meaning: Two short taps at the front. Someone new is speaking: touch the L, R or B pad within six seconds to tell Kandha where they sit.

patterns.name: Voice softened
patterns.meaning: One slow swell at the front. The voice became quieter or sadder-sounding than usual for that person.

patterns.name: Voice rose
patterns.meaning: Three quick taps at the front. The voice became louder or more intense than usual for that person.

patterns.name: Hesitation
patterns.meaning: A soft flutter at the front. The speaker paused several times in a few seconds.

patterns.name: Long silence, floor open
patterns.meaning: Two gentle ticks on both shoulders. Nobody has spoken for a while: the floor is open.

patterns.name: Queue noted
patterns.meaning: One short squeeze on both shoulders. Your 'I want to speak' request is on.

patterns.name: Still waiting
patterns.meaning: One longer squeeze on both shoulders, at most once a minute. You have been waiting to speak for a while.

patterns.name: Low battery
patterns.meaning: Three slow pulses at the back of the neck, once. The stole is at 20% and should be charged.

patterns.name: Someone without a seat
patterns.meaning: One tap at the front. A known voice is speaking but has no seat yet; press 1-4 or a pad to give it one.

patterns.name: Zone test
patterns.meaning: Two medium taps in the zone being tested.

patterns.name: Stole connected
patterns.meaning: Two tiny ticks on both shoulders when the stole links to the laptop.
